flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Director, Drug Development Project Management & Pipeline Strategy
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Position Summary: This role will partner closely with Quotient’s drug development project leaders and matrix teams to translate their scientific strategy into robust, integrated drug development project plans, and drive flawless execution of Quotient’s early drug pipeline. This role is accountable for planning, execution, and coordination across functional teams (e.g., drug discovery, translational medicine, biology, drug development strategy, and finance) as well as external CROs and collaborators. The successful candidate will coordinate and run drug development matrix project meetings, maintain governance-ready dashboards and decision logs, oversee budgets, contracts, and resource needs, and readiness for key drug development review milestones. By leveraging subject matter experts across key Research and Development functions to develop end-to-end drug development plans and execution strategies, this role will provide operational and planning leadership to drug development matrix teams, manage risks and interdependencies, consider regulatory and compliance requirements, and support reviews for Quotient’s Executive team and Board of Directors. This role will also support the development of Quotient’s drug discovery pipeline strategy with scenario-based analyses based on landscape and competitive intelligence data. Given the close integration of Quotient’s proprietary genetics platform into the drug discovery process, this role will interface with research operations and strategy to build a seamless, end-to-end view of Quotient’s R&D pipeline. This role will report to the Chief Development Officer (CDO). The role could be based at Quotient’s UK or US site. Responsibilities: With drug development matrix teams, support the translation of overarching drug development strategy and vision into integrated, detailed project plans (scope, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, risks) across functions. Monitor progress versus plan; proactively identify issues and interdependencies, escalate to project leads as needed, and coordinate cross-functional mitigation plans Schedule, structure, and run project team meetings (set agendas, pre-reads, minutes, action logs), track and drive closure of decisions and actions. Build and maintain governance-ready views (dashboards, status summaries, decision logs) to enable Quotient’s Executive team and Board of Directors reviews Support SMEs in operational execution with external partners (e.g., CROs), ensuring deliverables, timelines, and obligations are clearly understood and met. Support functional heads in forecasting and tracking resource needs (FTE, external partners) across projects and the pipeline, flag constraints and propose options. Coordinate budgets closely with the VP of Finance and track spend vs. plan and contracted scopes. Establish and maintain a structured risk and issue management process (identification, impact assessment, mitigation/contingency, owners, timelines). Support compliance with regulatory and quality expectations by organizing documentation and tracking contributions to regulatory submissions etc. Maintain shared repositories (SharePoint, dashboards, trackers) for plans, data summaries, and decision histories to improve transparency and continuity. Identify and implement continuous operational improvements to increase DD matrix team efficiency and focus on high-value scientific work. Support the development of Quotient’s drug discovery pipeline strategy and, with members of Research Operations and Strategy, develop a holistic and end-to-end view of Quotient’s Research and Development pipeline. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5f60e9ab-8e2c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Business Transformation & Operations based in India. This is a senior, high-ownership leadership role combining business transformation, operational excellence, client advisory, and commercial growth. You will diagnose complex organizational challenges across people, processes, technology, and management systems. The role goes beyond strategy, requiring you to turn recommendations into structured plans, implementation, training, and measurable outcomes. You will work directly with clients to understand their needs and shape engagements that address their most important business challenges. You will also contribute to proposals, presentations, business development, and closing new opportunities. Strong judgment and the confidence to constructively challenge senior leadership will be essential to driving meaningful change. This opportunity is particularly suited to an experienced transformation leader who wants broad ownership and the potential to grow into a General Manager-level role. Diagnose organizational performance and operating models across people, processes, technology, workflows, and management systems to identify root causes and improvement opportunities. Design and redesign organizational structures, workflows, processes, accountability models, and management systems to improve effectiveness and scalability. Translate strategic direction into actionable transformation plans with clearly defined owners, milestones, dependencies, priorities, and measurable evidence of results. Lead implementation initiatives from planning through execution and adoption, ensuring recommendations are effectively embedded into day-to-day operations. Coordinate training, change management, and stakeholder adoption activities, and verify that implemented solutions deliver the intended outcomes. Lead client discovery sessions to understand business challenges, objectives, operational realities, and desired outcomes. Translate client requirements into appropriate transformation strategies, service engagements, and practical solutions. Contribute to proposals, presentations, commercial discussions, and new-business development activities. Support the sales process by identifying opportunities, shaping solutions, communicating value, and helping move prospective engagements toward closure. Build strong relationships with clients and senior stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor throughout transformation initiatives. Constructively challenge executives and senior leaders when data, evidence, or operational realities indicate that a different approach is required. Apply AI, automation, and technology-enabled workflows to improve organizational efficiency, decision-making, and service delivery. Coordinate cross-functional teams and maintain alignment across transformation priorities, implementation activities, and business objectives. Requirements Significant leadership experience in organizational effectiveness, business transformation, management consulting, operational strategy, general management, or a closely related discipline. Demonstrated track record of taking transformation initiatives from diagnosis and strategy through implementation, adoption, and measurable results. Strong experience analyzing organizations holistically across people, processes, technology, structure, and operating models. Proven client-facing experience with the ability to build trusted relationships and communicate effectively with senior executives. Demonstrated sales, business development, consulting, or commercial experience, including contributing to proposals and closing new engagements. Advanced, practical experience using AI, automation, and technology-enabled workflows to improve business processes and outcomes. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6fc75e19-89a5-.title: Sr. Global Demand Planning Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:6fc75e19-89a5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Global Demand Planning Manager based in the United States. This is a strategic, highly analytical role responsible for leading the end-to-end demand planning process across U.S. and international markets. You will own an 18-month rolling forecast across multiple channels, regions, and product categories. The role plays a central part in connecting commercial demand signals with supply, inventory, and financial planning. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Supply Chain, Finance, and regional teams to create accurate and actionable forecasts. Using data, scenario planning, and continuous improvement, you will identify risks and opportunities before they impact the business. You will also lead the demand component of S&OP/IBP and help strengthen forecasting systems, processes, and decision-making. This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact in a mission-driven, innovation-focused environment serving customers across global markets. Own demand forecasts across DTC, DME, retail, distributor, and customer care channels across U.S. and international markets. Develop and maintain an 18-month rolling forecast at SKU, channel, and regional levels to support global purchasing and supply chain decisions. Lead the demand planning calendar, ensuring forecasts are accurate, timely, complete, and aligned with commercial and operational priorities. Lead the demand pillar of S&OP/IBP, creating alignment across Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, and regional stakeholders. Partner with Sales teams to incorporate pipeline expectations, promotions, product launches, and market intelligence into demand forecasts. Collaborate with Product and Marketing teams on new product introductions, campaigns, and demand-shaping initiatives. Work closely with Supply Planning and Finance to align demand forecasts with capacity, inventory targets, and financial plans. Analyze historical sales, promotions, product lifecycles, and market trends to identify demand patterns and improve forecast accuracy. Track and report key demand planning KPIs, including MAPE and forecast bias, at market and SKU levels. Identify forecast variances and root causes, proactively surface demand risks and opportunities, and implement corrective actions. Conduct scenario planning for new products, market expansion, promotions, and other significant changes in demand. Maintain strong data integrity and reporting accuracy to ensure stakeholders have reliable information for decision-making. Drive continuous improvement across forecasting tools, systems, processes, and reporting to increase visibility, agility, and planning effectiveness. Requirements Strong experience in demand planning, forecasting, supply chain planning, or a closely related analytical function, ideally within a global, multi-channel environment. Demonstrated ability to develop and manage rolling forecasts across SKUs, channels, regions, and markets. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with practical experience interpreting sales data, forecasting trends, variances, and forecast accuracy metrics. Experience with S&OP, IBP, or comparable cross-functional planning processes. Proven ability to translate commercial inputs such as sales pipelines, promotions, launches, and market intelligence into actionable demand plans. Strong business acumen and the ability to connect forecasting decisions with supply, inventory, financial, and commercial outcomes. Experience with scenario planning, demand-risk identification, and root-cause analysis. A continuous-improvement mindset with the ability to enhance planning processes, tools, reporting, and data quality. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Supply Chain. jobgether-jobgether:lever:749241ad-b914-.title: Google Cloud Delivery Architect
jobgether-jobgether:lever:749241ad-b914-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Google Cloud Delivery Architect based in Ireland. This is a senior, hands-on cloud architecture role focused on delivering complex Google Cloud engagements from design through implementation and handover. You will take ownership of scoped, fixed-budget projects and translate customer requirements into reliable production environments. The role combines cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, networking, security, and DevOps expertise. You will work directly with customers, lead technical discussions, and manage several engagements in parallel. You’ll also drive cloud migrations, establish secure landing zones, and modernize infrastructure through automation and GitOps. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on enterprise cloud transformation while operating with significant technical and delivery ownership. Own the end-to-end delivery of Google Cloud engagements, from low-level design and implementation through validation, documentation, knowledge transfer, and final handover. Design and execute cloud migrations from AWS or Azure to Google Cloud, including production workloads such as EKS to GKE, RDS to Cloud SQL, and S3 to Cloud Storage. Design and implement secure Google Cloud foundations and landing zones covering resource hierarchies, IAM, organization policies, networking, and security controls, with infrastructure codified in Terraform. Architect and deploy production-grade GKE environments, including private clusters, node pools, Workload Identity, Helm-based add-ons, ingress, autoscaling, and Cloud Armor. Enable DevOps and infrastructure automation by importing existing environments into Terraform, developing reusable modules, and implementing CI/CD and GitOps workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions and Argo CD. Manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously, maintaining delivery plans, project hours, scope, budgets, and timelines while identifying risks and budget deviations early. Lead customer-facing workshops, weekly meetings, technical discussions, and handover sessions with engineering teams, technical leaders, and CTO-level stakeholders. Protect project scope through effective change management and ensure that all delivered environments are supported by clear documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer. Apply AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully in architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, and delivery workflows while maintaining strong technical judgment and quality standards. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure and architecture experience, with deep production experience specifically in Google Cloud. Strong expertise in Terraform, including reusable and modular infrastructure code, remote state management, and importing manually provisioned environments. Proven production experience with Kubernetes and GKE, including private clusters, node pools, autoscaling, RBAC, Workload Identity, Helm, and ingress. Strong knowledge of Google Cloud networking and security, including VPC architecture, Cloud NAT, DNS, VPN, Private Service Connect, firewall policies, IAM, Organization Policies, and Secret Manager. Practical experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices, including GitHub Actions or equivalent, keyless authentication to Google Cloud, container workflows, and GitOps with Argo CD or similar tools. Working knowledge of AWS or Azure, with the ability to understand and assess source-cloud environments as part of migration projects. Strong customer-facing English communication skills, with confidence leading technical workshops, weekly meetings, presentations, and handovers. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical engagements, work within defined budgets and scopes, and take ownership of delivery outcomes. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7687db73-44b8-.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:7687db73-44b8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in India. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:98e01f12-4de9-.title: Director/Senior Director, Safety-PV Operations Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:98e01f12-4de9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director/Senior Director, Safety-PV Operations Lead based in Spain. This is a senior pharmacovigilance leadership role responsible for shaping and executing global safety operations across late-stage clinical development and commercialization activities. You’ll own the operational safety model, ensuring it remains lean, agile, compliant, and capable of supporting complex global programs. The role combines strategic oversight with hands-on execution, including vendor management, safety documentation, signal management, and regulatory readiness. You’ll work closely with medical safety, regulatory, quality, biostatistics, medical writing, and external partners to maintain high standards of patient safety and compliance. The position offers significant influence over safety processes, governance, systems, and operational strategy within a fast-moving biotechnology environment. You’ll collaborate across North America, Europe, and Israel, working with distributed teams and external vendors in a highly flexible setting. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to global drug development while helping build scalable safety capabilities for future commercialization. Provide strategic direction for global safety and pharmacovigilance operations, ensuring an effective, compliant, and cost-efficient operating model. Develop, maintain, and oversee safety operational documents and agreements with external partners, including Joint Operating Guides, Safety Management Plans, and Safety Data Exchange Agreements. Coordinate the development of core safety documents, including DSURs, Reference Safety Information within Investigator’s Brochures, CCSI, and RMP/REMS materials, in collaboration with Regulatory Affairs. Coordinate high-quality safety outputs with Biostatistics, Quality Assurance, medical writing, and external vendors. Support ongoing safety surveillance, including signal management, risk assessment, and periodic safety reporting. Serve as the primary point of contact for safety vendors and CROs, managing work orders, budgets, deliverables, administrative requirements, and overall performance. Monitor vendor safety KPIs, ensure adherence to Safety Management Plans, and oversee implementation of required risk mitigation measures. Establish and maintain safety procedures, governance models, and SOPs appropriate to the stage of product development and future commercialization. Partner with Quality Assurance to ensure appropriate safety training is implemented, completed, and documented. Work closely with global medical safety leadership and represent safety operations in governance and decision-making forums. Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs, PV Quality Assurance, medical writing, and other internal functions to align safety expectations and maintain regulatory compliance. Represent safety operations in interactions with development and commercialization partners. Participate in clinical trial teams and expanded-access or compassionate-use programs as required. Requirements: Advanced degree such as a PhD, PharmD, MSc, or equivalent in a life-science or medical discipline. At least 5 years of experience in a comparable pharmacovigilance or safety operations leadership role, with experience across both small biotechnology and larger pharmaceutical organizations. Demonstrated experience supporting late-stage clinical development, initial commercialization, and compassionate-use or expanded-access programs. In-depth knowledge of global pharmacovigilance and safety requirements, including GVP and 21 CFR Part 11. Strong understanding of pre- and post-marketing safety requirements and global regulatory expectations. Experience creating and maintaining CCSI and initial RMP/REMS documentation. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a824c6e9-2dbc-.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a824c6e9-2dbc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Greece. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios. Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles. Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks. Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities. Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios. Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis. Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Requirements Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows. Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial. southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:a70377.title: Office Operations Manager
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:a70377.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. As we scale rapidly across offices and teams, we are hiring an Office Operations Manager to own the day-to-day office experience of our company and support a consistent, high-quality onboarding and culture experience as the company grows. This role is critical to making sure the office runs smoothly, new hires feel oriented from day one, and the environment supports how Profound actually works. What you’ll do - Own day-to-day office operations, including arranging cleaning, maintenance, security, access, supplies, and general readiness - Manage inventory of office supplies, snacks, meals, and equipment - Coordinate with vendors and service providers including building, IT, cleaning, catering, and deliveries - Ensure the office is consistently functional, organized, and ready for people to do their best work - Help execute onboarding touchpoints such as welcome breakfasts, first-week moments, and basic social connection - Serve as the default in-office point person for questions, issues, and day-to-day needs - Help plan and execute team events, lunches, celebrations, and small rituals that support connection without slowing execution - Support visiting teammates and leaders with office setup, schedules, and logistics - Partner with Ops to maintain a consistent office experience as Profound grows across NYC, SF, London, and Buenos Aires Who you are - 0-3+ years of experience in office management, operations, hospitality, events, or a service-oriented role - Highly organized and reliable, with an ability to keep things running and notice issues before they become problems - Comfortable coordinating vendors, handling logistics, and managing multiple priorities at once - People-oriented and approachable, with teammates naturally coming to you when they need help - Low ego and high ownership, taking pride in doing the unglamorous work well - Thrive in a fast-growing startup environment where things change quickly and processes are built in real time Location This is an on-site role based in our SF or London office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $80,000 to $110,000 (SF). Comp may vary by location. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring. #LI-PRO Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members. Location: Speeders Car Wash (Fair lawn 1) 17-16 River Road, Fair Lawn, NJ 07410
